# `m.stocks.short_interest`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Short interest of US-listed stocks, one row per ticker and FINRA settlement date.

```python
m.stocks.short_interest(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Short Interest (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated every 2 weeks, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated every 2 weeks, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated every 2 weeks, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated every 2 weeks, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated every 2 weeks, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The primary ticker symbol for the stock." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `AvgDailyVolume` | long | The average daily trading volume for the stock over a specified period, typically used to contextualize short interest. | REST |
| `DaysToCover` | double | Calculated as short_interest divided by avg_daily_volume, representing the estimated number of days it would take to cover all short positions based on average trading volume. | REST |
| `SettlementDate` | String | The date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) on which the short interest data is considered settled, typically based on exchange reporting schedules. | REST |
| `ShortInterest` | long | The total number of shares that have been sold short but have not yet been covered or closed out. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
